cases.question: average speed per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: how many readings per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, count(*) AS reading_count FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY reading_count DESC

cases.question: what was the highest wave height
cases.sql: SELECT max(wave_height) FROM telemetry

cases.question: average water temperature across the fleet
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS time, AVG(water_temp) AS avg_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY time ORDER BY time LIMIT 5000

cases.question: minimum and maximum speed for each vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT vessel, min(speed) AS min_speed, max(speed) AS max_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour_bucket, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '2 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: max wave height per vessel per day
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, vessel, MAX(wave_height) AS max_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: daily minimum and maximum water temperature
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS x, vessel, min(water_temp) AS min_temp, max(water_temp) AS max_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: Aurora's average speed in 15-minute buckets over the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '15 minutes', ts) AS x_time, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY x_time ORDER BY x_time

cases.question: average wind per vessel in six-hour buckets
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '6 hours', ts) AS time_bucket, vessel, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: average speed by hour of day
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ts) AS hour_of_day, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day

cases.question: average wave height by day of the week
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT dayname(ts) AS weekday, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY case dayname(ts) when 'Monday' then 1 when 'Tuesday' then 2 when 'Wednesday' then 3 when 'Thursday' then 4 when 'Friday' then 5 when 'Saturday' then 6 when 'Sunday' then 7 end

cases.question: speed of Atlas every 10 minutes today
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', ts) AS time_bucket, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Atlas' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket

cases.question: water temperature trend for Aurora in the last week
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '4 hours', ts) AS time, avg(water_temp) AS temperature FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: which vessel was fastest on average in the last 24 hours
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: compare wave height of all vessels by hour over the last 12 hours
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS time_bucket, vessel, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '12 hours' GROUP BY time_bucket, vessel ORDER BY time_bucket, vessel

cases.question: mean speed for the last 30 minutes in one-minute buckets
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS x, vessel, AVG(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '30 minutes' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: Average wind from September 3 to September 5, 2026, hourly
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour_ts, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-03 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-06 00:00:00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Average wave height for the last hour in one-minute buckets
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS time_bucket, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket

cases.question: compare speed of Kestrel and Nomad by hour
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS time, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel IN ('Kestrel', 'Nomad') GROUP BY time, vessel ORDER BY time, vessel

cases.question: Compare vessel speed by hour over the last day excluding Aurora
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS x, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' AND vessel != 'Aurora' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: how many readings had waves above 4 metres, per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS count FROM telemetry WHERE wave_height > 4 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY count DESC

cases.question: Hourly average speed for vessels north of latitude 50 in the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS x, vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: Show hourly wind for Poseidon over the last 7 days
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour_bucket, vessel, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' AND vessel = 'Poseidon' GROUP BY hour_bucket, vessel ORDER BY hour_bucket

cases.question: in how many hours did Solstice see wind above 30 knots
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts)) AS hours FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Solstice' AND wind > 30

cases.question: table of the 10 highest hourly average wave heights
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour_time, vessel, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY hour_time, vessel ORDER BY avg_wave_height DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: the three fastest vessels by average speed in the past 7 days
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: which day had the strongest average wind
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_wind DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel recorded the coldest water
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, MIN(water_temp) AS lowest_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY lowest_temp ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel got farthest east
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, max(lon) AS max_longitude FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY max_longitude DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: correlation between wind and speed per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, corr(wind, speed) AS wind_speed_correlation FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: difference between maximum and minimum water temperature per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, max(water_temp) - min(water_temp) AS temp_diff FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY temp_diff DESC

cases.question: Compare speed and wave height by hour over the last 7 days
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour_time, avg(speed) AS avg_speed, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY hour_time ORDER BY hour_time

cases.question: Average ratio of wave height to wind speed per hour over the last day
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wave_height / wind) AS avg_ratio FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: average speed of each vessel in km/h over the last day
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, avg(speed * 1.852) AS avg_speed_kmh FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed_kmh DESC

cases.question: average speed per vessel in the first week versus the second week
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT vessel, CASE WHEN ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' + INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 'First Week' ELSE 'Second Week' END AS period, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' + INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY vessel, period ORDER BY vessel, period

cases.question: latest position of every vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, lat, lon, ts FROM (SELECT vessel, lat, lon, ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY vessel ORDER BY ts DESC) as rn FROM telemetry) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: where was Meridian yesterday
cases.sql:
-- view: map
SELECT lat, lon, vessel, ts FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Meridian' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '2 days' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' ORDER BY ts

cases.question: show all vessel tracks on a map
cases.sql:
-- view: map
SELECT vessel, lat, lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel, lat, lon, ts ORDER BY ts LIMIT 5000

cases.question: how many readings were taken north of 50 degrees latitude, per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS count FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY count DESC

cases.question: Aurora's average position per day
cases.sql:
-- view: map
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS time_bucket, avg(lat) AS lat, avg(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: average wave height per ves
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT vessel, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: wind
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS x_time, vessel, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: speed last week
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '3 hours', ts) AS x, vessel AS series, AVG(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY x, series ORDER BY x, series

cases.question: scatter of wind vs wave height
cases.sql:
-- view: scatter
SELECT wind, wave_height FROM telemetry LIMIT 5000
